## What is an inverting amplifier?
- It is an amplifier with an output that is the opposite sign to its input
**![](data:image/png;base64,)**
## Describe the connections of inverting amplifier
- Connect the non-inverting input to ground.
- Connect the output to the inverting input through a resistor, Rf.
- Connect the input signal to be amplified to the inverting input through a resistor, Rin.
**![](data:image/png;base64,)**
## Voltage gain formula for inverting amplifier
$$A_{cl} = -\frac{R_{f}}{R_{in}}$$
